---
name: "nf-core/fasta_newick_epang_gappa"
description: "Run phylogenetic placement with a number of query sequences plus a reference\
  \ alignment and phylogeny. Used in nf-core/phyloplace."
keywords:
- "phylogenetic placement"
- "phylogenetics"
- "alignment"
- "fasta"
- "newick"
components:
- "hmmer/hmmbuild"
- "hmmer/hmmalign"
- "hmmer/eslalimask"
- "hmmer/eslreformat"
- "clustalo/align"
- "mafft/align"
- "epang/filterquery"
- "epang/place"
- "epang/split"
- "gappa/examinegraft"
- "gappa/examineassign"
- "gappa/examineheattree"
input:
- ch_pp_data:
    type: "map"
    description: "Phylogenetic placement input, one entry per sample, where:\n\n-\
      \ `alignmethod` is the method used for alignment, 'hmmer', 'clustalo' or 'mafft'\n\
      - `queryseqfile` is a fasta file with query sequences\n- `refseqfile` is a file\
      \ with reference sequences, aligned unless an hmmfile is provided\n- `refphylogeny`\
      \ is a newick file with the reference phylogenetic tree\n- `hmmfile` is an optional\
      \ HMM file to use for alignment; implies that refseqfile is not aligned\n- `model`\
      \ is the phylogenetic model to use in placement, e.g. 'LG+F' or 'GTR+I+F'\n\
      - `taxonomy` is a tab separated file with taxonomy information for the reference\
      \ sequences\n- `min_query_columns` is optional, the minimum number of residues\
      \ a query must have in the\n  reference alignment columns that are not all gaps;\
      \ defaults to 1, the lowest value EPA-ng accepts.\n  A sample where no query\
      \ passes gets no placement outputs, only a warning and the `filterquery_table`\n\
      - `min_reference_coverage` is optional, the minimum fraction of those columns\
      \ a query must have\n  a residue in, between 0 and 1; defaults to 0\n\nStructure:\
      \ [\n  meta: val(meta),\n  data: [\n    alignmethod:  'hmmer',\n    queryseqfile:\
      \ path(\"*.faa\"),\n    refseqfile:   path(\"*.alnfaa\"),\n    refphylogeny:\
      \ path(\"*.newick\"),\n    hmmfile:      path(\"*.hmm\"),\n    model:      \
      \  \"LG\",\n    taxonomy:     path(\"*.tsv\"),\n    min_query_columns:     \
      \ 1,\n    min_reference_coverage: 0\n  ]\n]\n"
- compress_alignment:
    type: "boolean"
    description: "Write the clustalo and mafft profile alignments gzipped. Recommended\
      \ for large\nalignments, which are mostly gaps; hmmer alignments are not affected.\n"
output:
- epang:
    type: "directory"
    description: "All output from EPA-NG.\n\nStructure: [ val(meta), path(epang) ]\n"
    pattern: "*"
- jplace:
    type: "file"
    description: "jplace file from EPA-NG.\n\nStructure: [ val(meta), path(jplace)\
      \ ]\n"
    pattern: "*.jplace"
- epang_log:
    type: "file"
    description: "EPA-NG log file.\n\nStructure: [ path(log) ]\n"
    pattern: "*.epa_info.log"
- filterquery_table:
    type: "file"
    description: "Tab separated file with one row per query sequence: the number of\
      \ columns of the reference\nalignment with a residue, the number of those the\
      \ query has a residue in, the coverage, the\nnumber of those columns with an\
      \ unambiguous residue (not ?, N, X or O) and whether the query\npassed the filter\
      \ and was placed.\n\nStructure: [ val(meta), path(tsv) ]\n"
    pattern: "*.filterquery.tsv"
- grafted_phylogeny:
    type: "file"
    description: "Newick file with query sequences placed in reference tree.\n\nStructure:\
      \ [ val(meta), path(newick) ]\n"
    pattern: "*.newick"
- taxonomy_profile:
    type: "file"
    description: "Tab separated file with taxonomy information from classification.\n\
      \nStructure: [ val(meta), path(tsv) ]\n"
    pattern: "*.tsv"
- taxonomy_per_query:
    type: "file"
    description: "Tab separated file with taxonomy information per query from classification.\n\
      \nStructure: [ val(meta), path(tsv) ]\n"
    pattern: "*.tsv"
- heattree:
    type: "file"
    description: "Heattree in SVG format.\n\nStructure: [ val(meta), path(svg) ]\n"
    pattern: "*.svg"
- hmmbuild_log:
    type: "file"
    description: "hmmbuild output, for entries where the hmm was built from the reference\
      \ alignment.\n\nStructure: [ path(txt) ]\n"
    pattern: "*.hmmbuild.txt"
authors:
- "@erikrikarddaniel"
maintainers:
- "@erikrikarddaniel"
version: "0.0.0-0c0f63f"
license: "MIT License"
kind: "Workflow"
requires:
  modules:
  - "nf-core/hmmer/hmmbuild@0.0.0-6d1763b"
  - "nf-core/hmmer/hmmalign@0.0.0-6d1763b"
  - "nf-core/hmmer/eslalimask@0.0.0-6d1763b"
  - "nf-core/hmmer/eslreformat@0.0.0-6d1763b"
  - "nf-core/clustalo/align@0.0.0-6d1763b"
  - "nf-core/mafft/align@0.0.0-5eae6c7"
  - "nf-core/epang/filterquery@0.0.0-0c0f63f"
  - "nf-core/epang/place@0.0.0-5eae6c7"
  - "nf-core/epang/split@0.0.0-5eae6c7"
  - "nf-core/gappa/examinegraft@0.0.0-5eae6c7"
  - "nf-core/gappa/examineassign@0.0.0-5eae6c7"
  - "nf-core/gappa/examineheattree@0.0.0-5eae6c7"
